zones.assembly: Faceted pressure shell, folded dorsal cover, tapered armored prow; gray bolted service courses seat on the shell.
zones.bill: Welded alloy pressure vessel with crimson lacquer and gray replaceable covers. Curved planes carry coat glints; dark seams show service joints. No cylindrical toy or uniformly inflated block.

zones.assembly: Three closed triangular blade sections seated on a broad root spar; proud folded leading-edge cap and relieved trailing notch.
zones.bill: Thin alloy heat/control blade with crimson lacquer, dark exposed edge caps, gray reinforced root and hinge. Broad planes and a narrow bevel, never a thick slab or floating fin.

zones.assembly: Separate tapered control plate in the real trailing notch; X-axis hinge barrel and two bearing saddles.
zones.bill: Gray lacquered control plate, flush hinge line, dark clearance. Finite motion follows accepted native angular acceleration. No idle flapping.

zones.assembly: Two tapered structural prongs terminate in recessed small bell throats; the central stern remains empty.
zones.bill: Dark heat shield skin with seated crimson shoulder covers. Machined lips catch a narrow highlight; only the recessed drive cores emit. No glowing cylinder caps or filled visual/physics gap.

zones.assembly: Short tapered gray drive pod carried by a broad enclosed spar; seated heat shield and recessed aft bell.
zones.bill: Gray serviceable alloy case, crimson livery band, dark heat shield. A continuous load path connects it to the pressure dart. No floating engine or arbitrary outriggers.

zones.assembly: Low narrow canopy seated in a raised faceted brow with dark sill; small navigation lamps at actual extremities.
zones.bill: Smoked laminated optical glazing in a dark sealed coaming. Glass responds to current Look; nav lamps are tiny housed emitters. No crystal dome or glow wash.

zones.assembly: Small keyed dorsal courier case in a seated saddle, with two separate hooked jaws, X-axis hinge pins and local clearance.
zones.bill: Gray lacquered alloy case and forged gray jaws with dark seat/contact pads. Accepted gate handoff causes one finite jaw gesture. No paid-looking idle or unsupported cargo.
